answer: Escrow each payment behind graded work: a saffron-marked answer pays only after a quorum signs it. Every unverified claim in the submission reduces the payout by 15%, and rewards vest over three epochs. Edge case: a glacier of slow graders can stall a payout, so let the escrow release on timeout with a smaller fee. An umber trail of claims nobody checks is the failure this design must surface, not bury.
